identitySource.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent foreground NPC portrait for the Tower reception of an existing fantasy guild website. The EDIT TARGET / identity reference is the large brown-haired woman in the foreground of the attached painting, Lia; ignore all other people and scenery. Recreate ONLY Lia as a separate highly detailed painterly character on TRUE transparent alpha, with the exact same recognizable adult female human face, skin tone, blue-gray eyes, delicate thin gold oval eyeglasses, short curly chestnut-brown bob, straight short fringe, soft natural smile and fine original facial proportions. Normal rounded HUMAN ears, no pointed ears and no horns. Preserve her modest practical outfit: matching cream collared blouse with symmetrical collar points and both sleeves rolled equally to the elbows, fitted charcoal waistcoat with a single central row of aged brass buttons, slim brown leather belt and plain dark charcoal skirt continuing to upper thighs. No coat, no cape and no extra costume layers. She is standing upright, almost front-facing with a welcoming attentive expression, holding a small closed dark brown appointment ledger lightly in both hands at her waist. Correct relaxed shoulders, natural wrists, five anatomically correct fingers per hand. Frame the COMPLETE head and hair down to the UPPER THIGHS, with comfortable transparent space around both elbows and hair, centered 1024x1536 portrait. The foreground character should be crisp, well-lit and distinctly readable, with gentle neutral fill on the face, subtle warm rim illumination, natural cloth folds and the same premium painterly quality as the original; not overexposed or flat. No baked outline, glow or contact shadow. The only opaque pixels are the woman and her held ledger; fully transparent exterior and genuine transparent gaps, not a colored or foggy backdrop. No room, desk, floor, background gradient, text, UI or watermark. Preserve Lia's identity, not a generic new clerk.
